protocol.transition_policy: Diagnostic full-frame persistent tile changes only; moving people and clocks may trigger candidates. Never identify these as shared panel events or export timing without physical-panel correspondence and switch-delay validation. No manual annotations.
protocol.track_policy: Native-resolution dynamic-mask SIFT and forward/backward LK with adjacent patch correlation; terminate on appearance discontinuity. Convert coordinates by (xy+0.5)/2-0.5 before using immutable calibration. Preserve original moving-track and full-search support gates.
protocol.fit_policy: Replace all ten target edges with newly measured native temporal-bias estimates, never retain an older edge as fallback. Full-pair support >=12, unchanged +/-25 search and 0.25 gate; fractional refinement 0.01. Split full-search correspondences into two deterministic disjoint groups (seed0), each >=6 tracks, and require distinguishable nonboundary optima and inter-group lag agreement <=0.25. Groups are a consistency check, not substitutes for full-pair uncertainty or reserved validation.
protocol.failure_policy: If any targeted fit/group check or the complete graph fails, retain the result and stop at the evidenced blocker before reserved timing. No threshold relaxation or cycle-dependent pruning.
